Title: Module 1 - Configure Customer Applications and ATS Integrations (Customer Onboarding)

Blocks.Section: Module 1 - Configure Customer Applications and ATS Integrations (Customer Onboarding)
Blocks.Text: As a LinkedIn partner, you must complete the setup needed to onboard your customers to RSC. This includes setting up developer applications, enabling RSC, configuring atsIntegration settings, setting up authentication, and meeting compliance requirements. To complete Module 1 certification, demonstrate each applicable test case below to LinkedIn.

Blocks.Section: Module 1 - Configure Customer Applications and ATS Integrations (Customer Onboarding)
Module 1 - Configure Customer Applications and ATS Integrations (Customer Onboarding)
Blocks.Text: When your customers enable RSC, your application must support syncing all their historical candidates, applications, and jobs during onboarding. If your application filters or otherwise limits this sync, you must obtain written approval from your LinkedIn business development representative.

Blocks.Section: Module 1 - Configure Customer Applications and ATS Integrations (Customer Onboarding)
Blocks.Text: This module includes functional checks to verify that your customer onboarding setup works as expected and compliance checks to confirm that your application meets LinkedIn requirements. For details about rule IDs, test cases, and check types, refer to the certification overview.
Rule IDs are renumbered to make each test case unambiguous to reference. Use the following table to map the rule IDs used in earlier revisions of this page to the current ones.

Rows.Text: Enable RSC for a new customer
Onboard a customer with multiple Recruiter contracts
Record a demo and demonstrate TOS compliance
Enable, disable, and re-activate the integration
Verify full historical sync during onboarding
Demonstrate secure credential storage and rotation

Enable RSC for a new customer1. As an admin, open the LinkedIn integration admin page in your ATS.2. Locate the RSC integration option for the test contract and select Enable.3. Show that the ATS instance credentials, API key and secret, and the integration mappings, context organization URN and contract URN, are stored in the ATS.4. Refresh the admin page and show that the integration status now reads ENABLED.

• The admin sees the appropriately named integration in Recruiter and is able to enable it.• The ATS instance credentials, API key and secret, and the integration mappings, context organization URN and contract URN, are stored on your side.• The current enablement status of the integration is displayed on the ATS admin page.

Onboard a customer with multiple Recruiter contractsFor partners using provisioning.1. Enable RSC for two recruiter contracts of the same company, completing onboarding in two unique instances.2. Show that each instance gets a developerApplication keyed by a unique foreign ID, used on behalf of a single instance, and that the API traffic for each instance uses its own credentials.3. Negative test: run the two-part test. First, one child application with two or more contracts of the same company must succeed. Second, the same child application used to launch a contract of a different company must return an error, because a developer application must not serve more than one company.

• A customer can enable RSC for multiple recruiter contracts, both linked to the same company.• Developer applications are created for instances using a unique foreign ID of the instance, and are used on behalf of a single instance.• Activation for each instance, and its API traffic, corresponds to the API credentials created for that instance.• The onboarding experience completes in two unique instances.• One child application can serve two or more contracts of the same company. Using the same child application to launch a contract of a different company returns an error, because a developer application must not serve more than one company.

Store atsIntegration configuration settings1. Show that CALLBACK_URL is set for the provisioned application.2. Verify the settings for each customer through the Integrations Log Screen. The One-Click Export callback URL for each customer must be unique.3. Confirm that CALLBACK_URL is registered before the status moves to ENABLED, because One-Click Export depends on it.

• The atsIntegration configuration setting CALLBACK_URL is set.• CALLBACK_URL is verifiable for each customer for the provisioned application, for example through the Integrations Log Screen.• Enabling the integration alone doesn't make One-Click Export functional. The CALLBACK_URL must be registered before the integration status moves to ENABLED.

Configure the JS SDK domainFor partners using provisioning.1. In the developer portal, or in a provisioning API call response, show the JS SDK domain set to the domain that hosts your solution for the developer application of the customer.2. Show how you verify the domain for each customer, for example through the Integrations Log Screen.
The JS SDK domain is set correctly to a domain hosting your solution for the developer application of the customer, and is visible in the developer portal or in a provisioning API call response.

Verify the access token lifecycle1. Generate an access token through the OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials flow.2. Periodically validate that the token is still valid.3. Detect token expiry.4. Re-trigger the flow to refresh the token on expiry or invalidation.
• An access token can be periodically verified as valid.• Access token expiry can be detected.• The OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials flow can be re-triggered if a token has expired or been invalidated.

Record a demo and demonstrate TOS compliance1. Schedule and record a demo with LinkedIn that covers all core feature functionality of your ATS.2. If you're flagged for a TOS violation, demonstrate the remediation.3. Confirm that the trust and safety compliance audit is complete before certification.

• You agree to participate in a recorded demo with LinkedIn where you demonstrate all core feature functionality of your ATS.• If you were flagged for a TOS violation that you agreed to remediate as a condition of the partnership, you must demonstrate that the violation has been remediated.• The trust and safety compliance audit must be complete before certification.

Enable, disable, and re-activate the integration1. From the LinkedIn integration admin page in your ATS, enable, disable, and then re-enable the integration, showing the status at each step.2. After disabling, show that the client ID and secret are retained, not deleted.3. On re-activation, show that the same child developerApplication is reused and no new application is created, that widget onboarding is completed again, and that a full historical backfill is triggered.4. Note that full disablement requires contacting LinkedIn support. The ATS toggle alone doesn't fully disable the integration.

• Enable, disable, and then re-enable the integration. The enablement status must reflect the correct state at each step on the ATS admin page. Enable and disable are toggled from the LinkedIn integration admin page.• Developer application credentials, client ID and secret, must be retained when the integration is disabled. They must not be deleted.• On re-activation, the same child developerApplication is reused, a new one must not be created, and widget onboarding must be completed again. A full historical backfill is then triggered.• Full disablement requires contacting LinkedIn support. The toggle in the ATS alone doesn't fully disable the integration.

Verify full historical sync during onboarding1. Enable RSC for a fresh test customer and complete widget onboarding.2. Show that the full historical sync of all candidates, applications, job requisitions, and other entities begins automatically when onboarding completes, with no manual trigger.3. If any filter or variation from a full sync exists, present the written approval from LinkedIn for it.

• When a customer enables RSC, you must be able to sync all historical candidates, applications, job requisitions, and other entities for that customer, not a partial subset.• The full historical sync must begin automatically as soon as the customer completes widget onboarding. No manual trigger is required.• Any deviation, filter, or variation from a full historical sync requires written approval from LinkedIn. You must provide that approval as a deliverable.• This capability is exercised end-to-end by the historical data syncing test cases in Module 2.

Provide the provisioning mappingFor partners using provisioning.1. Produce a mapping of the unique foreign ID of each instance to the provisioned developerApplication client ID.2. Show that the mapping demonstrates the strict relationship of one application to one instance to one company.

Share a mapping between the unique foreign ID of each instance and its provisioned developerApplication client ID, demonstrating the strict relationship of one application to one instance to one company. This mapping is a certification prerequisite used for verification by LinkedIn during code review.

Configure the evaluation callbackFor Connected Projects.1. Show that EVAL_CALLBACK_URL is set and that the URL is reachable.2. Confirm that the integrationContext (organization URN, urn:li:organization:{id}) used to register EVAL_CALLBACK_URL isn't mixed up with an integrationContext used in another LinkedIn integration.3. Show that the ATS can receive and handle an EXPORT_APPLICATION_EVALUATION push notification.

• The atsIntegration configuration setting for EVAL_CALLBACK_URL is set, and the URL is reachable.• The integrationContext (organization URN) used for EVAL_CALLBACK_URL isn't mixed up with the integrationContext saved by other LinkedIn integrations.• The ATS can receive and handle a push notification with the type EXPORT_APPLICATION_EVALUATION. This is exercised end-to-end in Module 3.

Verify enabled integration types1. For the developer application of the customer, enumerate the enabled integration types, such as CSA_API, IN_ATS_INDICATOR, ONE_CLICK_EXPORT, and PROFILE_PLUGIN.2. Show how you check which types are enabled or disabled for each customer.

For the developer application of the customer, enumerate and verify that each enabled integration type is configured and active, such as CSA_API, IN_ATS_INDICATOR, ONE_CLICK_EXPORT, and PROFILE_PLUGIN. Confirm that you can check which integration types are enabled or disabled for each customer.

Demonstrate secure credential storage and rotation1. Show that credentials are stored encrypted, not in plaintext, and redacted from all logs.2. Rotate or re-issue a credential and show that OAuth re-triggers correctly. Refer to RSC-101-005.3. Show that credentials are retained across a disable, as described in RSC-101-007, but protected at rest.

• API keys and client secrets are stored securely, not in plaintext, and are never logged. Credentials such as keys, secrets, and tokens must be redacted from any request, response, or debug log.• Credential rotation and re-issue work, and a rotated or invalidated credential correctly re-triggers the OAuth flow, as described in RSC-101-005.• Credentials are retained across a disable, as described in RSC-101-007, but protected at rest.

Configure job availability types1. In the ATS, show the option that lets the customer choose the job availability type, PUBLIC or PRIVATE, for synced jobs.2. Sync one job of each type and show the resulting availability in LinkedIn.3. If your ATS can’t offer this choice, show that it posts jobs of type PRIVATE_TO_ATS_INTEGRATION only.
• The ATS provides an option for the customer to choose the job availability type, PUBLIC or PRIVATE.• If you can’t provide this choice, you post jobs of type PRIVATE_TO_ATS_INTEGRATION only.
